args.sql:
WITH chain_stats AS (
    SELECT
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        ANY_VALUE(zadanie) AS zadanie,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_success,
        MAX(nomer_popytki) AS max_attempt,
        COUNT(*) AS attempts_in_chain
    FROM "08_fonovye_zadaniya"
    GROUP BY kod_tsepochki_zapuskov
),
chain_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        zadanie,
        COUNT(*) AS total_chains,
        SUM(CASE WHEN has_success = 1 AND max_attempt > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS target_chains,
        AVG(CASE WHEN has_success = 1 AND max_attempt > 1 THEN attempts_in_chain ELSE NULL END) AS avg_attempts_target
    FROM chain_stats
    GROUP BY zadanie
)
SELECT
    zadanie,
    target_chains * 1.0 / total_chains AS share_target_chains,
    avg_attempts_target
FROM chain_metrics
ORDER BY zadanie
